hypothesis: One fixed regularized context regressor per unchanged setup; predicts net signal R from contemporaneous structure/volatility/volume/cost evidence. This is a new exploratory calibration after both static and rolling-PF failures; all failures retained.
gate: Predicted net R>=0.15 AND predicted net R minus0.5declared decision costR>0.05; no fitted threshold sweep. Forecast is not a confidence probability or guaranteed return.
trainingLabels: Only independently tracked shadow proposals whose exit-candle close was known strictly before train.until; unfinished and invalid outcomes excluded. No validation labels, metrics, or asset pruning enter training.
selection: Actual canonical arbitrator, close-observed lifecycle, one underlying asset, maximum3active signals. Four experts are frozen before their validation outputs are evaluated. Raw label-book proposal stream is a conservative subset of possible scanner events and is not complete runtime participation certification.
disclosure: Calendars repeatedly examined in this project; exploratory new model, not project-wide untouched holdout. All four models and all stage results retained. Any connected-runtime claim requires exact native-feature/inference parity and a fresh release review. This diagnostic cannot promote itself.
